classification.boundary: Class assignments and characteristic values of technical objects.

core.boundary: Shared basic views: location / account assignment, status flags, characteristics.

equipment.boundary: Current equipment master with standard postal address, multilingual texts, scoped partners, active statuses, user statuses, long-text index and address versions. Dedicated applicable child exports preserve partners, profiles/user statuses, texts and object identity; see OBJECT_COVERAGE.md.

equipment_bom.boundary: Equipment BOM assignments and versioned header, selection and item ledgers.

functional_location.boundary: Functional locations, texts and alternative labels. Dedicated applicable child exports preserve partners, profiles/user statuses, texts and object identity; see OBJECT_COVERAGE.md.

long_text.boundary: Index of long texts of EAM objects (content via READ_TEXT in the load program).

maintenance_notification.boundary: Open PM notifications with items, causes, tasks and activities. Dedicated applicable child exports preserve partners, profiles/user statuses, texts and object identity; see OBJECT_COVERAGE.md.

maintenance_order.boundary: Open maintenance orders with operations, components, settlement rows and permit assignments. Dedicated applicable child exports preserve partners, profiles/user statuses, texts and object identity; see OBJECT_COVERAGE.md.

maintenance_plan.boundary: Maintenance plans with items, cycles and the schedule restart point.

measurement_document.boundary: Last reading per measuring point (initial readings on S/4HANA).

measuring_point.boundary: Measuring points and counters of equipment and functional locations.

object_partner.boundary: Partner assignments of technical objects, notifications and orders.

object_status.boundary: Active user statuses of technical objects, notifications and orders.

task_list.boundary: Maintenance task lists with operations, object allocation, component/PRT/package references and provisional latest-counter selection.

work_center.boundary: Work-center headers, texts, cost centers and capacity references.

asset_balance.boundary: Asset fiscal year balances source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

asset_transaction.boundary: Asset transaction history source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

fixed_asset.boundary: Fixed assets source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

goods_movement.boundary: Goods movement history source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

material_stock.boundary: Inventory balances source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

product.boundary: Material master source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

purchase_order.boundary: Purchase orders source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

purchase_requisition.boundary: Purchase requisitions source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

purchasing_contract.boundary: Purchasing contracts. Select EKKO document category K and approved contract types; exclude purchase orders and scheduling agreements. Verify validity, value versus quantity contract, remaining target obligation and releases against the contract. Link account assignments and time-dependent conditions; release history is evidence, not a second purchase-order load. Supplier, CO/PS and account mappings require cross-domain approval.

purchasing_info_record.boundary: Purchasing info records. Migrate general and purchasing-organization data at their separate grains. Supplier/business-partner mapping and units are prerequisites. EINE current net price does not supply complete time-dependent conditions: export the configured purchasing condition tables, KONH/KONP and scales as a linked set with validity, access key and deletion checks. Do not claim complete condition coverage from EINA/EINE alone.

inspection_lot.boundary: Inspection lots source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

inspection_plan.boundary: Inspection plan reference source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

inspection_result.boundary: Inspection results source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

master_inspection_characteristic.boundary: Master inspection characteristics. Retain plant, characteristic, version and language. Verify released status, quantitative/qualitative control indicators, limits, units, inspection methods and catalog/selected-set dependencies in full-row export. Short texts are included; long texts need the native text API. Do not infer active version solely from greatest version number.

quality_notification.boundary: Quality notifications source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

sampling_procedure.boundary: Sampling procedures. DDIC must verify QDSV keys and the selected sampling/valuation fields. A procedure also depends on sample size rules, sampling schemes, dynamic modification and valuation settings; export those through the native QM configuration interface and verify the complete dependency set. Sampling procedure headers alone are not a complete statistical sampling scheme.

budget.boundary: Project overall and annual budgets. Separate original budget, supplements, returns, releases and transfers by verified value type and transaction semantics; do not sum all BPGE/BPJA rows as available budget. Currency, object ownership, fiscal year and availability-control settings must be enriched and approved. Reconcile overall and annual budget separately through a supported budget interface.

commitment.boundary: Project commitments. COOI grain and fields must be confirmed from DDIC before extraction. Tie commitments to approved PR/PO items and their remaining obligations. Commitments are generally regenerated from migrated purchasing documents: never post both a commitment history and its purchasing source. Enrich object and controlling-area currencies before monetary checks.

investment_measure.boundary: Investment programs and measures. Verify investment-program hierarchy and annual approval, assignments to WBS/internal orders, investment profiles, budget distribution and asset-under-construction settlement. IMTP/IMPR/IMZO are candidate configuration/reference structures, not a finished investment-measure posting schema. Preserve externally meaningful identifiers and map internal object numbers.

network.boundary: Project networks and activities. AUFK contains other order types too: select network types using verified order-type customizing, then close AFKO/AFVC/AFVV against the selected networks. Map internal routing, WBS and work-center IDs. Relationships, capacities, dates and status need the approved network business interface; this is no status replay.

project.boundary: Projects source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

project_cost.boundary: Project cost history source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

wbs_element.boundary: WBS elements source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

bill_of_material.boundary: Material bills of material source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

production_confirmation.boundary: Production confirmations. Preserve confirmation/counter identity and reversal relationships; do not delete reversals and assume the remaining history is net yield. Target order/operation mapping and posting periods must be approved. Reposting confirmations can trigger backflush, goods movements, activity allocations and accounting; confirmation history is reference-only unless a supported process migration explicitly authorizes those effects.

production_order.boundary: Production orders source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

production_order_operation.boundary: Production order operations source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

production_version.boundary: Production versions. Verify production-version validity, lot-size ranges, lock/check status and the effective BOM/task-list combination. Materials and plants are cross-domain prerequisites. Distinct production versions may intentionally overlap; evaluate availability for a version identity rather than rejecting every material-level overlap. REM planning levels require release-specific interface review.

routing.boundary: Routing reference source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

allocation_cycle.boundary: Allocation cycles and segments. Cycle headers and segments alone are insufficient. Export sender/receiver rules, set membership, tracing factors, accounts, plan/actual context, iterations and company restrictions through the verified native cycle configuration export. T811* table categories and keys vary; use the full-row helper where CDS is unavailable. Do not insert T811* or recreate cycles by posting journal entries; validate and execute a test cycle in the target.

cost_actuals.boundary: Actual cost history source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

cost_center.boundary: Cost centers source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

cost_element.boundary: Cost element references source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

internal_order.boundary: Internal orders source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

planning.boundary: CO primary and secondary cost planning. COSP/COSS also contain actuals: approve the plan value types and versions explicitly. Preserve period blocks, periods 01–16, fiscal-year variant, controlling/object/transaction currencies and debit-credit semantics. Resolve cost objects and accounts first. Target ACDOCP planning is not a field-for-field copy of these totals; choose a supported plan import and map period/currency types.

profit_center.boundary: Profit centers source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

address.boundary: Complete native ADRC keys shared by customer, supplier and bank masters.

bank.boundary: Bank master. Bank country and key identify the bank; preserve country-specific key formats and deletion status. House banks, house-bank accounts, bank account management and customer/supplier bank details are distinct objects and require their own approved interface/configuration. Do not treat bank master as a bank account balance.

customer.boundary: Customer source data source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

gl_account.boundary: G/L accounts source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

gl_line_item.boundary: Accounting document history source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

gl_opening_balance.boundary: Dedicated G/L opening balances. Choose classic OR new G/L for each ledger population; do not union both. DDIC must confirm all ledger dimensions and include any additional keys. Period 00 is carryforward, not period 01; calculate cutoff totals from the approved fiscal-year/period contract, including special periods only as intended. Enrich currency types from ledger/company configuration and classify accounts from SKB1. Exclude balances already supplied by FI-AA/AP/AR/open-item migration; reconcile migration clearing accounts to zero. No automatic totals-to-posting transformation is supplied.

open_items.boundary: Current and cleared item indexes source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

supplier.boundary: Supplier source data source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

address.boundary: Native VBPA partner records and ADRC address versions shared by SD documents.

billing_document.boundary: Billing document reference source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

outbound_delivery.boundary: Outbound delivery reference source records, preparation and comparison contracts.

pricing_condition.boundary: Pricing condition records and scales. Export every configured condition access table (Axxx or customer tables) at its actual DDIC key and link KNUMH to KONH/KONP and scales. KONH alone loses the customer/material/sales-area access key; the configured access export is mandatory. Include supplements, exclusions, deletion, validity, calculation-type-specific percentages/currencies/units and scale type. Never confuse master condition records with document conditions (KONV/PRCD_ELEMENTS), or divide every rate by the same factor.

sales_order.boundary: Sales orders source records, preparation and comparison contracts.
